lines.text: God appointed a law in Israel and commanded the fathers to teach it to their children.
The archers of Ephraim turned back in battle, though God had worked wonders in the region of Goshen.
God split the sea, led them with a cloud by day, and split the rocks in the wilderness.
God opened the doors of the heavens, rained down manna, and rained fish like the sand of the sea.
God was compassionate, forgave their iniquity, and remembered that they were but flesh.
